title: On the maximum density of $r$-graphs in which every $(r+1)$-set spans $0$ or $2$ edges
summary: In 1984, Frankl and Füredi asked for the maximum density of an $n$-vertex $r$-graph in which every $(r+1)$-set of vertices spans $0$ or $2$ edges. They gave a construction with asymptotic density $2^{1-r}$. We significantly improve this bound by constructing such $r$-graphs with density $Ω(r^{-3})$, thereby improving the dependence on $r$ from exponential to polynomial. We also obtain lower bounds for the more general problem in which every $(r+1)$-set spans an even number of edges from $\{0,2,\ldots,2k\}$.
